title: feat(bodk7): body-slide kills k=7 reverse: t=19 vs t=37
science: FORCING NEGATIVE that fixes the shape of the whole search: the body-slide rule beta = mu + cost 3 on EVERY 3->3 hop destroys reverse already at k=7 on B_21 (t=19 vs 37, 1083<1369). Because a body-diagonal geodesic must traverse ~3k support-3 hops, any blanket 3->3 tax multiplies t_body and swamps the axis gain. This is why every later winning clause (rho3, zeta, pi) must be a SELECTIVE 3->3 tax the body route can dodge.
